title: Caltech Robot Builds Part of a Structure in Orbit
paragraphs: A robot built something in space. The robot is from Caltech. Caltech is a university in the United States.
The team sent the robot to space in March 2026. It was a test. The robot had two parts of a frame. Then it built a third part by itself. No astronaut helped.
The team wants to build a big antenna. It is not ready now. The robot built only a small part. But the test works.

questions.a: No, only a small part is ready.
